newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Cetes rate closes flat on liquidity drain.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Cetes rate closes flat on liquidity drain.

text.p: Mexico's overnight Cetes rate gained from earlier lows to close unchanged at 25.25 percent on Tuesday after the central bank drained liquidity from the system, traders said.
"The fact that Banco de Mexico drained liquidity today rather than inject it changed the market trend somewhat," a trader said. "The market thus turned around, but turnover was very small."
Overnight rates on Cetes had reached a low of 24.00 percent during the session.
Banco de Mexico sold 546 million pesos worth of Cetes on the secondary market by auction, which it assigned at two days at a rate of 25.25 percent.
"The auction seemed to be a good idea, as there was an excess of liquidity in the market," a dealer said.
Overnight rates on bank paper meanwhile closed unchanged at 25.75 percent.
Mexican financial markets will be closed on Wednesday, January 1 for New Year's Day.
